title: British man's naked body 'found beside goat's head' amid fears of ritual killing in Sicily
text: Police are investigating the death outside of the remote town of Canicattini Bagni (Picture: Facebook) Mystery surrounds the death of a British man with locals fearing his death could be connected to esoteric rituals. Benjamin John Braithwaite,35,was found dead by a makeshift tent on the land surrounding an abandoned Sicilian farmhouse on Sunday morning. A goat’s head,drug paraphernalia,and a rope were discovered close to his naked body just a few kilometres from the town of Canicattini Bagni,according to local media reports. It was reported that the Brit had been camping in the area for a few days and had been looking to join up with the nomadic group settled in the Sicilian mountains. A few people staying at the camp will be interviewed by police after neck injuries were discovered. Hippie communities have taken up lodgings close to the Sicilian coastline (Picture: Getty)
